name: douyin-mix
doc: mix (curated collection) episode list (capability G SeriesChain / proposals H, P2): the completeness/follow-update face for series content — episode mapping, missing-episode detection, update cursor. Evidence: corpus GET /aweme/v1/web/mix/aweme/?mix_id=...&cursor=...&count=... (f2 MIX_AWEME / E0 fetch_user_mix_videos, corpus request shape cursor=49&count=6 -> 6 items, next cursor 55, has_more=1) -> {aweme_list[full detail aweme], cursor:<next page start>, has_more, item_id_to_episode:'<JSON string id->ep>', log_pb, status_code}; oracle probe: full chain 3 pages 13 episodes, episode map 13 entries with values exactly 1..N, unique ids, repeat-walk deterministic. The mix_id is discovered passively from detail/search cards' mix_info.mix_id (probe: 8/20 search cards carry it). Episode map binding is document-level (a JSON-string map on the envelope, not per item).
